# `.github/`

GitHub-specific contribution templates and workflow guidance.

- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md` pre-fills the project work-item format used for new issues.
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` keeps PR descriptions focused and records the
  linked issue.
- `README.md` explains this directory.

GitHub displays the issue and pull-request templates when contributors create
those items. The broader workflow and engineering expectations are in the root
`CONTRIBUTING.md`.
